openwrt_wiki.einleitung: The Ubiquiti U6 Long Range (U6-LR) is a PoE powered 802.11ax WiFi 6 access point with 8 spacial streams. The design is approximately a 9" (220mm) disk designed for wall mounting or can be layed flat on a shelf.
openwrt_wiki.wichtig: Devices with manufacturing date 2234 (34rd week of 2022) and later appear to be a version 3 hardware with a different (1 GbE only) Ethernet PHY chip. Flashing v2 firmware to this hardware will result in inoperable Ethernet.
openwrt_wiki.v1_vs_v2: v1's LED has full RGB color support while v2's has limited blue/white colors (supply shortages); v1 image on v2 not fatal, only LED error
openwrt_wiki.v3: Since about summer 2022 there is a v3 device with a RTL8211 PHY. The v3 is not compatible with v1/v2 images. Use a v3 image (since 23.05). Check: 23.05.5/24.10.2 'dmesg | grep mtk_soc_eth' -> 'PHY [mdio-bus:00] driver [RTL8211F Gigabit Ethernet] (irq=POLL)'; earlier 23.05.x 'dmesg | grep mtk_sgmii_init' -> 'detect RTL8211_CARD'. PHY table: AQR112C = v2, RTL8211 = v3. Note: as of early 2024, it appears that both v2 and v3 are in production.
openwrt_wiki.installation: factory reset (reset ~10 s); MAC on rear panel middle line next to QR code, also in QR code; DHCP or default 192.168.1.20 (old stock 192.168.1.34); SSH ubnt/ubnt; check hardware version; scp sysupgrade image to /tmp; mtd 6:bs 8:kernel0 9:kernel1; stock 6.2+ write protected partitions need unlock; bootselect flag bs; dd image to kernel0 and kernel1 (~2 min each); first boot ~4 min, LED flashes white/off; solid blue = done; OpenWrt default 192.168.1.1/24, DHCP server on LAN, wifi disabled
openwrt_wiki.ubootmod: alternative 'ubootmod' images (preloader, bl31-uboot.fip, initramfs-recovery.itb, squashfs-sysupgrade.itb) replace bootloader; do not mix variants
openwrt_wiki.flash_layout: mtd0 Preloader 0x40000, mtd1 ATF 0x20000, mtd2 u-boot 0x60000, mtd3 u-boot-env 0x10000, mtd4 Factory 0x40000, mtd5 EEPROM 0x10000, mtd6 bs 0x10000, mtd7 cfg 0x100000, mtd8 kernel0 0x1ee0000, mtd9 kernel1 0x1ee0000 (erasesize 0x1000)
openwrt_wiki.debricking: bootloop symptom: white LED flashes twice, dark ~30 s, repeat. Hold reset while plugging PoE, 15-20 s until LED alternates white-blue-off; recovery IP may differ (e.g. .31), may ignore ping, use ARP scan; stock firmware (6.7 branch worked) renamed firmware.bin; tftp put; 5-10 min re-flash
openwrt_wiki.netzwerk: lan 192.168.1.1/24; wlan0 radio0 802.11bgn disabled; wlan1 radio1 802.11nacax disabled

openwrt_git_v3.titel: mediatek: add support for Ubiquiti UniFi 6 LR v3
openwrt_git_v3.text: Some recent models of the Ubiquiti Networks UniFi 6 LR access point come with a RealTek RTL8211FS 1000M/100M/10M PHY instead of the Aquantia AQR112 2500M/1000M/100M/10M PHY used in both v1 and v2. Add build for this variant so we can support Ethernet with the PHY.
